name: Maharlika IX Route Servers
notes:
Maharlika IX is a proudly Filipino-built internet exchange, designed to make connectivity more affordable and accessible across the Philippines.

Focused on delivering cost-effective solutions, we serve content to underrepresented providers and aim to bring our internet exchange directly to customer networks.

Guided by the principles of makabayan and makamasa, Maharlika IX is committed to empowering the nation through better digital access for all.
